messages:
oncall-bot: Paging @emily @raj — P0: spike in 5xx+gateway timeouts across inference-gateway (region-us-west). Auto-sla alert triggered at 06:12 UTC. See summary: 5xx rate from 0.2% -> ~12% in 5m.
oncall-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-2102345678. Runbook: kv/prefix-cache -> check cache health, routing, and prefetchers.
emily: acknowledging, taking lead. Starting triage.
emily: quick view: increased errors align with high kv-miss rate on prefix-cache (shard p-3). Latency of backend calls to kv-store up ~3x.
emily: dashboard snapshot: 
- gateway 5xx surge 06:10-06:15
- prefix-cache hitrate drop 98% -> 40%
- backend kv QPS normal but tail latency increased

raj: I'm on logs. Seeing lots of "kv: prefix cache corruption read-fallback" in gateway logs, then immediate 502/504s. Example: 
```
{"ts":"2026-03-15T06:12:18Z","svc":"gateway","msg":"prefix cache read failed","shard":"p-3","err":"kv-corrupt: checksum mismatch","req_id":"req_9f3a"}
```

michael: Are we seeing evictions or disk errors on the kv nodes? I can check infra.

ops-lead: grabbing infra telemetry. No disk OOMs, but mem pressure spikes on the prefix cache nodes around the same time; eviction rate up 20x. Could be a cascading eviction storm.

emily: mitigation thought: disable prefix-cache read-before-fetch for p-3 or fallback to cold reads so gateway doesn't crash on corruption. Also consider temporary route around p-3.

raj: I can flip a gateway flag to force bypass prefix-cache reads for that shard. Prep change: `/cfg set gateway.cache.read_prefix=false --shard p-3` (dry-run).

emily: Good. Let's do a controlled toggle on one edge cluster first (us-west-1-edge-2). Rollout steps in runbook.

michael: infra notes: can divert traffic from p-3 to p-4 by updating routing tag set; will do after the gateway toggle to avoid double failure.

emily: Action list: 1) raj flip gateway read bypass on one edge 2) monitor 5xx and kv-miss metrics 3) if stable, roll to other edges and update routing 4) engage cs for impacted customers.

raj: flipping on us-west-1-edge-2 now. Command: `POST /admin/flags` body: `{ "flag": "gateway.cache.read_prefix", "value": false, "scope": "edge:us-west-1-edge-2" }`

raj: done. Observability: 5xx for that edge dropped from 14% -> 1.8% within 60s. prefix-cache errors for that edge reduced.

emily: Good signal. Start rolling to us-west-1-edge-1 and us-west-1-edge-3. Keep each step 60s and watch.

michael: Routing update queued: shifting 30% traffic from p-3 -> p-4 after second edge toggle to avoid filling p-4 cache.

ops-lead: note — increased cold-kv reads will increase backend cost but preferable to 5xx. Also possible KV compaction needed.

laura-cs: I got alert from support: several enterprise customers reported elevated errors. ETA to notify customers?

emily: Laura — send a preliminary note: "We're investigating elevated 5xxs in US-West; mitigation underway. Some requests may see degraded latency. We'll provide updates in 30m or on resolution." Add link to this thread.

laura-cs: Sending now. Short note: "We're aware, mitigations in progress. No action needed from you at this time. Updates in ~30m."

raj: rolling to remaining edges now. us-west-1-edge-1 -> done. us-west-1-edge-3 -> done.

raj: metrics: global gateway 5xx dropped from peak 12% -> 1.5% over 5m after full edge rollout. prefix-cache error logs decreased by ~95%.

emily: Follow-up actions: 
- Leave prefix-cache read bypass for p-3 disabled while we investigate corruption root cause.
- Schedule KV store consistency check/compaction for p-3.
- Run background validation job: sample keys, checksum verify.
- Postmortem + customer impact assessment.

michael: I'm provisioning a temporary extra cache node for p-3 to reduce eviction pressure and give us headroom for compaction. ETA ~25m.

ops-lead: Added alert to watch tail latency on backend kv after compaction starts.

emily: Handoff: @michael will continue remediation and infra changes. I'll keep monitoring and start incident writeup drafts. @raj step down after 30m or when all read bypass flags are recorded.

raj: Ack. Logging all flag changes and timestamps to incident log.

laura-cs: Customer update sent at 06:30 UTC. Copy of message posted to #inc-2102345678.

emily: Quick safety check: run `curl -s https://us-west-1-edge-2.gateway/healthz` — returning 200 on edges with bypass. For failing edges prior to change, we're seeing 502.

ops-lead: KV compaction job started at 06:45 UTC for p-3 (background, low-priority). Progress logs: `compaction: 12% done; verified 42k keys`

michael: added temporary cache node to p-3 cluster at 06:50 UTC. Eviction rate down 70%.

emily: Good. Monitoring shows 5xx steady ~1.2% (within SLA bucket for degraded performance).

ops-lead: compaction completed 07:05 UTC. Post-compaction checksum mismatch rate fell to baseline.

raj: rolling read-prefix bypass OFF for edges (starting non-critical edge us-west-2-edge-1). Doing a canary by re-enabling read on one edge.

raj: canary edge OK. Re-enabled on all edges for p-3. No spike in 5xx after 10m.

emily: Closing mitigation: revert temporary cache node after stabilization window. Schedule follow-up: full RCA, why corruption occurred (possible premature eviction + async write race), and implement stronger checksum/repair path.

laura-cs: Final customer update sent at 07:30 UTC: "Issue mitigated; root cause under investigation; some customers saw transient 502/504s between 06:10-06:50 UTC."

emily: Incident declared resolved at 07:35 UTC. Moving to postmortem. Thanks everyone. :tada:

oncall-bot: Incident status: RESOLVED. Summary: Prefix-cache corruption + eviction storm on shard p-3 triggered elevated 5xx. Mitigations: gateway read-bypass, traffic shift, extra cache node, kv compaction. Incident age 1h23m.

emily: Adding next steps to postmortem: automated early warning for checksum error counts, safer cache eviction backpressure, stronger prefetch validation. Assigning owners in doc.

michael: I'll own infra follow-ups (cache capacity + compaction automation).

raj: I'll own gateway-safe-fallbacks and flagging instrumentation.

laura-cs: I'll prepare customer impact summary for account owners.

emily: Thanks all. Closing thread and moving notes to postmortems/2102345678-pfx-cache-rca.md
